headline: 255 votes: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir elected Bangladesh’s 23rd president
summary: The former student activist and BNP leader has secured a victory over Colonel (Retd) Oli Ahmed, receiving 255 votes in the parliamentary election.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. The Election Commission has issued a formal notification confirming the result of the election held on Thursday, August 20.
In a closely monitored vote, Fakhrul secured 255 votes, while his opponent, Colonel (Retd) Oli Ahmed, received 88 votes.
The election took place in the parliamentary session room from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Out of 349 total voters, 343 votes were cast.
Following the victory, the newly elected president received congratulations from Chief Adviser Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the Prime Minister, and the President-elect's own party colleagues.
International congratulations have also poured in from China and the United Kingdom, recognizing the new head of state.
Mirza Fakhrul, who rose from a student activist to the highest office in the land, is now set to step into Bangabhaban as the guardian of the state.
caption:
From the streets to Bangabhaban: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir wins the presidency with 255 votes.

Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. The Election Commission has issued a formal notification confirming the result of the election held on Thursday, August 20.

In a closely monitored vote, Fakhrul secured 255 votes, while his opponent, Colonel (Retd) Oli Ahmed, received 88 votes.

The election took place in the parliamentary session room from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Out of 349 total voters, 343 votes were cast.

Following the victory, the newly elected president received congratulations from Chief Adviser Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the Prime Minister, and the President-elect's own party colleagues.

International congratulations have also poured in from China and the United Kingdom, recognizing the new head of state.

Mirza Fakhrul, who rose from a student activist to the highest office in the land, is now set to step into Bangabhaban as the guardian of the state.

headline: Ruhul Kabir Rizvi appointed BNP acting secretary general
summary: The appointment comes after Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was elected president of the party.
details: BNP Standing Committee member Ruhul Kabir Rizvi has been appointed as the party's acting secretary general with immediate effect.
The appointment was announced in a press release signed by BNP Assistant Office Secretary Muhammad Munir Hossain, citing Section 7(b)(6) of the party constitution.
This development follows the election of Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as the BNP president.
Mirza Fakhrul had previously resigned as secretary general on August 13 to contest the presidential election.
Rizvi, who was made a member of the party's Standing Committee on August 15, also serves as a political adviser and adviser to the Ministry of Industries with ministerial status.
caption:
Ruhul Kabir Rizvi takes over as the acting secretary general of the BNP.

BNP Standing Committee member Ruhul Kabir Rizvi has been appointed as the party's acting secretary general with immediate effect.

The appointment was announced in a press release signed by BNP Assistant Office Secretary Muhammad Munir Hossain, citing Section 7(b)(6) of the party constitution.

This development follows the election of Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as the BNP president.

Mirza Fakhrul had previously resigned as secretary general on August 13 to contest the presidential election.

Rizvi, who was made a member of the party's Standing Committee on August 15, also serves as a political adviser and adviser to the Ministry of Industries with ministerial status.
